## How to Manage Dry, Brittle Hair at Home


If you notice your hair becoming dry or brittle, don’t panic—you can reverse it with the right high-quality home remedies for dry hair. Learn more about what brittle hair is and how to fix it.


## What Is Brittle Hair (and What Causes It)?


Brittle hair feels dry. Frizziness, dullness, and split ends are also signs you’re dealing with brittle hair. You might notice more hair breakage than usual, and your hair might be more difficult to style.


There isn’t one single cause of brittle hair. Dyeing your hair, using hot tools or harsh hair products, or washing it too frequently can make it brittle. Dry air or tight hairstyles can also cause brittle hair. You might also notice drier[hair as you age](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/can-your-hair-type-change-with-age) . Fortunately, there are treatments for dry hair that can restore moisture to your hair.
